accepted.sourceLabel: SunPower document 505701 Rev H / LTR_US, September 2017; exact SPR-E20-327-COM electrical table, page 2
accepted.reviewNote: Accepted exact-module STC ratings only. Manufacturer Rev H visually reviewed on page 2; its 327-COM table reads 54.7 V, 5.98 A, 64.9 V, 6.46 A. Both SanTan listings carry the exact SKU family and their per-module bullets independently show the same values (single listing: https://www.santansolar.com/product/used-sunpower-327w-solar-panel-silver-framed/; pallet: https://www.santansolar.com/product/used-sunpower-327w-solar-panel-com-pallet-of-20/). Baseline pallet panelRatings contain the same numeric values as 54.7V / 5.98A / 64.9V / 6.46A; preliminary-delta conflicts are formatting-only on these rows, so retain baseline source/value strings. Pallet dimensions and 950 lb weight are shipment-level and remain untouched; do not add the datasheet's 41 lb / module and module dimensions over them. Do not add efficiency or Pmax temperature coefficient: Rev H gives 21.4% and −0.35%/°C while the older Rev F sheet gives 20.3% and −0.38%/°C, and the used listings do not identify a sheet revision. The generic voltage/current coefficient rows are not assigned to Voc/Isc. Ratings are per panel, not pallet totals.

held.reason: Hold both identities in full; do not import a hybrid STC record. SanTan's exact CS6X-300P listing and pallet page claim 300P but give Imp 8.41A and Isc 8.97A. The photographed manufacturer table assigns those current ratings to the adjacent 305P row. Its CS6X-300P row is 300W, Vmp 36.1V, Imp 8.30A, Voc 44.6V, Isc 8.87A; the 305P row is 305W, Vmp 36.3V, Imp 8.41A, Voc 44.8V, Isc 8.97A. This is a model-to-rating conflict in both retailer product listings, not a pack/module-unit discrepancy. Because current and power ratings identify incompatible listed variants, do not salvage the apparently matching voltage/other rows into a hybrid identity until the actual panel nameplate/lot is resolved. The same retailer values occur on the single listing (https://www.santansolar.com/product/used-canadian-solar-300w-solar-panel/) and pallet listing (https://www.santansolar.com/product/used-canadian-300w-solar-panel-pallet-of-25/).
